description: The RECONFIGURATIONS of a project's rooms in a window: before every occurrence whose layout matters and whose units stand elsewhere — put there by an earlier occurrence ('by'), or where they stand of themselves — one reconfiguration, ending when the occurrence begins ('for') and lasting the sum of its units' 'moveMinutes'. Each has 'steps' (what, from, to), 'checklist' (Markdown, «what, from, to, who»), 'returning' (every unit goes back where it stood before the occurrence that moved it — the return after a rental: as it was / as it is now), the roles it asks for and keeps away and 'people' who may do it, and its place in its week: 'number', 'ceiling', 'overCeiling' (waiting for an administrator's word), 'approved'. 'weeks' counts them per week. Any member may read.

to.description: Window end, ISO 8601. Default: a week after the start; at most 400 days.
